Look outside. Dark, right? Imagine it never got dark again.
Guess first: how many people live under skies that never get truly dark? Comment a percent.

text: Over eighty percent! City lights keep the night glowing.

Over a third of us can't even see the Milky Way anymore.
Night light lowered the sleep hormone melatonin in every animal species studied.
Birds sang earlier. Trees budded earlier. Insects pollinated less.
In Tromso, Norway, the sun doesn't set from late May to late July.

text: And right now, the opposite starts there: no sunrise until mid January.
Endless day or endless night? Comment day or night.
